records.name: Pakistan
records.summary_text: Pakistan is dangerous for trans travellers — legally progressive on paper but severely undermined in practice. The 2018 Transgender Persons Protection Act is described as one of the most progressive pieces of legislation internationally, but the national religious court (the Shariat Court) gutted it in 2023, declaring provisions "un-Islamic".
